sql: SELECT pr.PromotionCategory, sum(f.SalesAmount) AS revenue, sum(f.DiscountAmount) AS total_discount, sum(f.DiscountAmount) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(f.SalesAmount + f.DiscountAmount), 0) AS avg_discount_pct FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f JOIN retail.DimPromotion pr ON f.PromotionKey = pr.PromotionKey WHERE f.PromotionKey <> 1 GROUP BY pr.PromotionCategory ORDER BY revenue DESC
